about: An hour of talk while Rome is offline (A8). The facts a question after Rome is back can ask about: the boat crew wants everyone at the slip at seven on Tuesday; the June gap was the logger battery (dm-member3 only); buoys go back at B, C and E first, A, D and F the week after.

messages.text: Quick one while I remember: the boat crew wants us at the slip by seven on Tuesday, not eight.
May backfill is done. June has a two-week gap from the 9th.
The battery packs came a day early. Fitting them this afternoon.
Then we could redeploy Monday after all? No, the slip is closed. Tuesday stays.
I've put the summary table draft in the shared drive, under salinity.
Packs fitted on 14 to 16. 17 to 19 tomorrow morning.
The survey team asked for the route maps by email. Sending now.
Note: the June gap was the logger battery, not the network.
New label printer arrived. It's on the shelf by the door.
Decision from the call with the harbour master: buoys go back in at positions B, C and E first, A, D and F the week after.
